title: Monoidal functor
html:
Remark. Monoidal functor

Monoidal functor. A functor F \colon \mathbf{C} \to \mathbf{D} between monoidal categories equipped with a natural transformation \mu_{X,Y} \colon F(X) \otimes F(Y) \to F(X \otimes Y) and a morphism \epsilon \colon \mathbf{1}_{\mathbf{D}} \to F(\mathbf{1}_{\mathbf{C}}). These are compatible with the associator and unitors.

Mathlib distinguishes lax monoidal functors (arbitrary morphisms) from strong monoidal functors (isomorphisms).

Mathlib reference. CategoryTheory.Functor.LaxMonoidal (class). CategoryTheory.Functor.Monoidal (class) for strong monoidal. Import: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Monoidal.Functor.
